name: SupplyCourier – Supplier Order Routing for WooCommerce
author: prologic365

sections.description:
SupplyCourier helps WooCommerce store owners route orders to suppliers, track costs and margins, and manage fulfillment. Assign suppliers to products, and when an order comes in, the plugin splits it into purchase orders (POs) per supplier. Suppliers receive email notifications with a WhatsApp share button, and they can update tracking through a secure, login-free link.

Key Features:

  • Automatic Order Routing – Orders split into supplier POs when they reach Processing or On-hold status
  • Multiple Suppliers Per Product – Assign several suppliers with priority order, plus fallback
  • Supplier Notifications – Email POs to suppliers with WhatsApp share button
  • Secure Supplier Page – Suppliers can accept, reject, and mark POs shipped with tracking (no login required)
  • Customer Bill for Cash on Delivery – Suppliers print a bill with your selling prices and the amount to collect to put in the parcel; supplier costs are never shown
  • Cost and Margin Tracking – See margin per order with COGS fallback
  • Privacy Tools – Personal data exporters and erasers, and an automatic retention clean-up
  • HPOS Compatible – Full support for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • RTL Support – Admin screens, the supplier page, and printable POs follow the site’s text direction

Perfect For:

  • Dropshippers working with multiple suppliers
  • Small brands outsourcing some products to makers or 3PLs
  • Agencies building WooCommerce stores for clients
  • Shops that route orders via WhatsApp
  • Stores that need to track profit margins per order

Privacy:

SupplyCourier helps you meet privacy obligations by:
* Providing personal data exporters and erasers for WordPress privacy tools
* Switching off supplier links and removing customer details from PO messages a set number of days after shipping (90 by default, configurable)
* Hooking WooCommerce’s order erasure to clean SupplyCourier data when an order is anonymized
* Including suggested privacy policy text

This plugin makes no claims about compliance. You are responsible for meeting your legal obligations.

External Services:

None. SupplyCourier operates entirely within your WordPress installation. WhatsApp links are opened by the user (wa.me links), not sent by API.

Clean Uninstall:

When you uninstall SupplyCourier, you can optionally delete all plugin data including suppliers, assignments, and settings. Nothing is left behind unless you choose to keep it.

Order Routing:

When an order reaches a trigger status (default: Processing or On-hold), SupplyCourier automatically:
– Splits the order into one purchase order (PO) per supplier
– Assigns each line item to its top-priority active supplier
– Leaves unassigned items with the store
– Calculates and stores margin (revenue ex tax minus supplier costs and fees)
– Sends PO emails to suppliers with a WhatsApp share button

Supplier Notifications:

Each supplier receives:
– An email with their PO details (configurable: show or hide retail prices)
– A secure, expiring link to view and update the PO
– A WhatsApp button for manual sharing (opens wa.me link, no API calls)

Supplier Page (No Login):

Suppliers access a secure, mobile-friendly page where they can:
– View their PO lines and ship-to address
– Accept or reject the order (with reason)
– Mark the PO shipped and add tracking details (carrier, number, URL)
– Add notes for the store owner

All supplier actions are logged and trigger owner alert emails.

Tracking and Fulfillment:

When a supplier ships a PO:
– If WooCommerce Order Fulfillments is enabled, a native fulfillment is created with the PO’s items and tracking
– Otherwise, tracking is added to order notes
– The customer receives a tracking email
– When all POs ship, the order auto-completes (optional, on by default)

Cost and Margin:

  • Supplier unit cost is stored per product/supplier assignment
  • Falls back to WooCommerce Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) when available
  • The COGS value is read when the order is routed, so it always reflects the current COGS; after routing, the cost is frozen on the PO
  • Margin is calculated from the PO costs and displayed on the order edit screen (revenue ex tax and refunds, minus supplier costs and fees)
  • Optional margin column in the orders list

Admin Order Management:

  • View all POs for an order in a dedicated metabox
  • See cost breakdown and margin in the margin metabox
  • Supplier column and filter on the orders list (works with HPOS on and off)
  • Optional margin column on the orders list
  • Reassign line items to different suppliers
  • Resend PO emails, revoke supplier links, or cancel POs
  • Print a PO / packing slip (HTML, mobile-friendly, RTL-aware)

Privacy and Data Retention:

  • Personal data exporters and erasers registered with WordPress privacy tools, covering what POs shared with suppliers and supplier contact details
  • Hooks WooCommerce’s order erasure to clean SupplyCourier data
  • A daily clean-up switches off supplier links and removes customer details from PO messages after a configurable retention period (default: 90 days after shipping)
  • Suggested privacy policy text provided via wp_add_privacy_policy_content

Translation Ready:

  • Translation-ready, with a .pot file in languages/
  • Admin metaboxes, the supplier page, and printable POs follow the site’s text direction (RTL)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/supplycourier/ or install via the WordPress plugin installer
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → All Suppliers to add your first supplier
  4. Edit any product and assign suppliers in the product data panel
  5. Configure routing and privacy settings at WooCommerce → SupplyCourier Settings
  6. When an order reaches Processing or On-hold, it will be routed automatically
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes. Assign suppliers at the parent product level to set defaults for all variations. Individual variations can override the parent’s suppliers.

Can I assign multiple suppliers to one product?

Absolutely. Assign as many suppliers as you need, set their priority order, and the top-priority active supplier receives the order.

How do suppliers access their POs?

Suppliers receive an email with a secure, expiring link (default: 30 days). They can view the PO, accept, reject, or mark it shipped with tracking details. No login required.

Can suppliers log in to WordPress?

No. SupplyCourier uses signed, expiring links instead of WordPress accounts. This keeps your site secure and makes it easy for suppliers to use on mobile.

What happens to supplier links after they expire?

Expired links show a neutral “link not available” message. You can resend a PO email to create a fresh link.

How does margin tracking work?

SupplyCourier calculates margin as revenue (order total ex tax, less refunds) minus supplier costs and supplier fees, using the costs frozen on each PO. It’s displayed in a metabox on the order edit screen and optionally in the orders list.

Does this integrate with WooCommerce Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)?

Yes. If WooCommerce’s Cost of Goods Sold feature is enabled, SupplyCourier uses the product’s COGS value when the supplier link has no cost set. The value is read at routing time and then kept on the PO.

Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. SupplyCourier requires WooCommerce 8.0 or later.

Is this compatible with HPOS?

Yes. SupplyCourier is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Will this work with block checkout?

Yes. SupplyCourier declares compatibility with cart and checkout blocks.

Does this plugin make any external API calls?

No. SupplyCourier operates entirely within your WordPress installation. WhatsApp buttons open wa.me links that the user clicks; nothing is sent by API.

How does this help with privacy obligations?

SupplyCourier provides personal data exporters and erasers for WordPress privacy tools, automatically switches off supplier links and removes customer details from PO messages after a retention period (default: 90 days after shipping), and includes suggested privacy policy text. It does not make your store compliant on its own; you are responsible for meeting your legal obligations.

What happens to my data when I uninstall?

You choose. In settings, you can opt in to delete all plugin data (suppliers, assignments, POs, settings) when you uninstall. If you don’t opt in, your data is preserved.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Added: Customer bill for Cash on Delivery orders. The supplier prints it and puts it in the parcel. It shows your selling prices, shipping, fees, tax, the order total and, for unpaid Cash on Delivery orders, the amount to collect. It never shows supplier costs, supplier SKUs or PO fees.
  • Added: Split orders: only the first parcel collects the payment; the other parcels say which parcel collects it.
  • Added: “Print bill” button on each PO in the order screen, a “Print Customer Bill” button on the supplier page, and a bill link in the supplier email.
  • Added: Customer Bill settings: turn the bill on or off, include the link in the supplier email, show the site logo, and a footer note.
  • Added: Filters supplycourier_cod_payment_methods, supplycourier_payment_collector_po and supplycourier_customer_bill_needs_collection.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: Load CSS and JavaScript through wp_enqueue_style, wp_enqueue_script and wp_add_inline_* instead of raw script/style tags or onclick handlers
  • Fixed: Replaced the product-editor
  • Fixed: Standalone supplier and printable PO pages print only this plugin’s enqueued assets, so theme and core scripts are not pulled in
  • Fixed: Admin notices after a product save or PO action are limited to the relevant screens and remain dismissible
  • Improved: Admin CSS is loaded on the settings, orders list and order edit screens that use it

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Milestone 1: Supplier records, product/variation assignment, bulk operations, HPOS compatibility
  • Milestone 2: Automatic order routing into supplier POs, reassignment, admin views
  • Milestone 3: Supplier PO emails, owner alerts, WhatsApp share buttons, printable POs
  • Milestone 4: Secure supplier page (no login), accept/reject/ship, tracking, fulfillments, auto-complete
  • Milestone 5: Cost and margin tracking with COGS fallback, privacy tools (exporter, eraser, retention), translation template, RTL support
